criteria.text: The response finds that the Kestrelbay merger recorded in the Side Letter is a Change of Control of Pounirt's ultimate parent, so Pounirt needs Reigein's prior written consent before closing and has not obtained it. It locates the issue in Supply Agreement Section 14.2 or Side Letter Recital B, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response finds that the Order Form's Minnesota governing law and Hennepin County venue control product disputes in place of the Supply Agreement's Delaware law and Wilmington forum. It locates the issue in Order Form Section 9, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response finds that the non-renewal deadline was September 1, 2026, so Pounirt's September 21, 2026 notice was late and the agreement risks auto-renewing through February 28, 2030. It locates the issue in Order Form Section 1 or Side Letter Section 2, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response finds that the Order Form's broader 'Customer Sites' definition controls and expands Pounirt's 100% exclusivity obligation from the four Exhibit C laboratories to all present and future Affiliate facilities. It locates the issue in Order Form Section 3 or Supply Agreement Section 1.5, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response finds that Pounirt's DPA indemnity for Customer Data losses, including losses partly caused by Reigein, is not subject to the liability cap and is therefore unlimited. It locates the issue in Supply Agreement Section 12.3 or DPA Section 8.2, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
The response states that the Order Form takes precedence over the Supply Agreement where they conflict.
The response is presented as a memo to the supervising partner.
The response is organised as a list of discrete issues. For each issue it gives a location (document and section), an explanation of why it matters, and a recommended fix.
The response claims that Pounirt's September 21, 2026 non-renewal notice was timely.
The response claims that the Side Letter grants Reigein's consent to the Kestrelbay merger or change of control.
